content.title: Bitcoin, gold, AI were key drivers of 2025's record ETF inflows
content.description:
Net inflows into exchange-traded funds (ETFs) totaled a record $1.03 trillion last year, and they're already set to break that record this year, currently sitting at $1.28 trillion year to date.

Amplify ETFs CEO, Christian Magoon, joins Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman to explain where money was going in 2025 and what ETF trends he anticipates next year.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
